canon.name: Kaiju Attack
canon.frame: a wide view of a giant monster attacking a miniature model city in bright afternoon light, watched by a high fixed camera on a rooftop, the whole skyline framed from the street in the near foreground to green hills and a bay behind
canon.still: The camera holds perfectly steady on the whole city for the whole clip while the monster breathes heavily, smoke drifts from the rooftops and tiny cars race through the streets below
canon.approach: In the first half second, a bright searchlight beam whips across the city and lands on {thing}
canon.arrive: {thing} crashes into view {place} in a huge burst of dust
canon.leave: {thing} is flung far over the hills and out of view in a puff of dust
canon.settle: In the last second, the dust settles and the camera holds perfectly steady on the whole city, the monster, every building and every vehicle in place while thin smoke drifts
canon.ambient: Air raid sirens wail far off, the monster rumbles and breathes, and tiny car horns honk in the streets
canon.selectSound: A loud dramatic brass stab from a monster movie orchestra
canon.lettering: condensed 1960s sans capitals in crisp white
canon.style: vivid 1960s monster movie film, saturated colors
